name: portal
summary: Deploys the owned Helm-based Automation Portal demonstration.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles the named Helm release, namespace, and owned AAP OAuth integration.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before Helm deployment when architecture, trusted AAP API access, or chart prerequisites fail.

readiness: The owned Portal Helm release is ready.
The AAP API integration validates against the configured CA.

security.secret_storage: Generated OAuth values are retained only in owned protected configuration.
security.network_trust: AAP API requests require a trusted CA and do not disable TLS verification.
security.external_actions: Portal AI remains opt-in and no hosted provider is selected automatically.
